text:
Predicates:
Monday(x) ::: x is a Monday.
Time8pm(x) ::: x is 8 pm.
Rose(y) ::: y is a rose.
GivenOutOnTV(y, x, t) ::: rose y is given out on TV on day x at time t.
OnTheBachelor(z) ::: z is on the Bachelor.
PortraysLivesOfRealPeople(s) ::: show s portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTVShow(s) ::: s is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad ::: Breaking Bad show.

Premises:
∃x ∃t (Monday(x) ∧ Time8pm(t) ∧ ∃y (Rose(y) ∧ GivenOutOnTV(y, x, t))) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀y ∀x ∀t (GivenOutOnTV(y, x, t) → OnTheBachelor(y)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀z (OnTheBachelor(z) → PortraysLivesOfRealPeople(z)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀s (PortraysLivesOfRealPeople(s) → RealityTVShow(s)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTVShow(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.

Conclusion:
∃x ∃t (Monday(x) ∧ Time8pm(t) ∧ BreakingBadOnAt(BreakingBad, x, t)) ::: Breaking Bad is on Monday at 8 pm.
